metadata.title: Product Capabilities | Retail Lending Assistant
metadata.description: Customer ledger, intelligent interviews, OCR, profiles, product matching, marketing scripts, follow-up management, and one-click summaries for retail relationship managers.

announcement.title: Eight core work modules for retail relationship managers

hero.title: Eight capabilities connect customer management to follow-up summaries
hero.description: Every capability has an interactive workspace. Follow the standard business sequence to reduce repeated preparation and keep customer information reusable.
hero.tip: Select any capability to open its complete workspace.

usage.label: Standard workflow
usage.title: Move from customer opportunity to follow-up in four clear steps
usage.description: Human review points remain visible throughout, combining AI efficiency with business control.

items.title: Screen and capture
items.description: Prioritize customers, upload core documents, and add interview notes.

items.title: Profile and match
items.description: Build the profile, confirm needs, and identify product directions and open conditions.

items.title: Prepare outreach and documents
items.description: Create talking points and a dynamic checklist for relationship-manager review.

items.title: Package and follow up
items.description: Compile the post-meeting package and schedule the next customer action.

pain_points.label: Common relationship-manager pain points
pain_points.title: Core pain points
pain_points.description: Scattered information, inconsistent judgment, and repeated document requests consume relationship-manager time while weakening customer experience and conversion.

items.title: Information is reconfirmed across stages
items.description: Customer details are spread across interviews, documents, and systems, forcing repeated checks at every handoff.

items.title: Conversation outcomes are hard to reuse
items.description: Calls, messages, and meeting notes lack a common structure, so each follow-up starts with manual rework.

items.title: Intent assessment depends on experience
items.description: Needs and buying signals are not consistently marked, making prioritization dependent on individual judgment.

items.title: Product recommendations lack a standard narrative
items.description: Rationale, eligibility, and risk boundaries vary by person, making proposals harder for customers to understand.

items.title: Document requirements are unclear upfront
items.description: Checklists change during the process, creating repeated submissions and slowing the next business step.

features.title: Eight capabilities aligned to the retail outreach sequence
features.description: Start with the customer ledger, then move through interviews, document capture, profiling, product matching, outreach, follow-up, and final summaries.

items.title: Customer ledger
items.description: Manage and filter customers to identify today's highest-priority opportunities.

items.title: Intelligent interview management
items.description: Turn conversations into needs, concerns, and open questions.

items.title: License and statement OCR
items.description: Extract key fields from licenses and statements for human review.

items.title: Unified customer profile
items.description: Consolidate customer, operating, relationship, and current need data.

items.title: Product matching
items.description: Present product directions, matching rationale, and open conditions.

items.title: Intelligent marketing scripts
items.description: Create editable guidance for calls, messages, and meetings.

items.title: Materials and follow-up management
items.description: Track document completeness, feedback, and next actions.

items.title: One-click summary
items.description: Compile needs, matching, scripts, materials, and follow-up actions.

cta.title: Start with the customer ledger and build a complete outreach workflow
cta.description: Open the first capability and experience the sequence from customer screening to final summary.
